defects.title: Global VLM budget cap (<7 calls) & silent default-PASS on skipped or errored late chapters
defects.before_r5r6: Global vlm_calls < 7 cap skipped later beats; VLM errors or unsampled beats risked soft fallback instead of fail-closed UNCERTAIN.
defects.after_r5r7: Removed global 7-call cap in semantic_comprehension_critic.py; enforced per-chapter risk-adaptive VLM budget (max_vlm_calls_per_chapter=10) and strict fail-closed UNCERTAIN on any VLM_ERROR or unsampled material claim (never defaults to VERIFIED).
defects.evidence: test_r5r7_generative_cinematic_composition.py::test_d02_vlm_error_never_defaults_pass; canonical run audited 9/9 material claims across ch_00 with uncertain_claims_count=0.

defects.after_r5r7: Built StoryBible (story_bible.py) + GenerativeVisualPlanner (generative_visual_planner.py) with ReadOnlyEvidenceToolRegistry, zero claims[:10] truncation, full chapter coverage validation, and structured composable BeatProgram V4 object/camera/motion graphs.
